reasoning: Independent AN/control sample retests NR1H3 methylation. Discussion explicitly attributes failure to both reference 21 (own hypomethylation finding) and reference 20 (earlier hypermethylation finding); include both papers. Reference 23 provides contextual concordance but is not explicitly presented as an independently targeted finding. Within-paper technical validation of newly discovered DMRs is not replication of a published finding. Some original participants also appear in sensitivity analyses, but the main analysis is independent. Author lists copied in abbreviated form as printed.
